education/fluent-db-updater.description: Atomically update all 6 Fluent learner databases (learner-profile, progress, mistakes, mastery, spaced-repetition, session-log) at session end by calling .claude/hooks/update-db.py with a single JSON payload. education/fluent-review.description: Run today's spaced-repetition review queue — items scheduled by SM-2 that need reinforcement before the learner forgets them.
